whatItIs.statement: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from, triggered by a button.

whenToUse.statement: Use Select when the user needs to choose a value from a predefined collection of options.

howToUse.statement: Compose Select with a trigger and value plus content containing the available items.
Use groups, labels, and separators to organize items when the option set needs structure.
Preserve the component's managed focus, keyboard navigation, and typeahead behavior when using it.

Select is a supported control inside Field: give SelectTrigger the id that FieldLabel htmlFor targets, set aria-invalid and aria-describedby on SelectTrigger rather than on Select, and set required and disabled on Select, which Radix reflects onto the trigger.

options.statement: Use a custom placeholder when no value has been selected.
Use the documented positioning option when the selected item needs a different relationship to the trigger.

writing.statement: Provide a visual and accessible label for the select.
